instruction_context.meaning: v16を上書きせず、訂正記録、同一commit固定、post-commit照合、Work 1再確認を行う説明済みの修復案を進める

approved_scope: record that documentation revision v16 did not become git-reconstructable
create a corrective successor snapshot record without rewriting v16
commit the corrective snapshot and fixed inputs as one change set
verify every manifested artifact from the containing commit
create Work 1 fixed-input Evidence v2 after successful verification
update the operational checklist and session handoff
excluded_scope: semantic changes to the current Intent, Glossary or Plan
rewriting or deleting documentation revision v16
starting Work 1A before the repair and Work 1 re-verification pass
authority_effect: authorizes the bounded provenance repair only
